parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Kenpoly-sec-school-field (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1874 | 2.78 | 2.78
2 | 2428 | 9.13 | 11.9
3 | 1071 | 15.2 | 27.1
4 | 3706 | 32.2 | 59.3
5 | 178 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as KHK-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Kenpoly-sec-school-field (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: KHK-type
Aquifer depth: 59.3 m and below (Layer 5, resistivity 178 ohm-m)
Recommendation: Target drilling beyond 59.3 m to intersect the low-resistivity Layer 5, which is interpreted as the main water-bearing (aquiferous) zone; ensure proper casing/sealing through the overlying resistive layers (1–4) to prevent cross-contamination and borehole collapse during drilling.
